id-nd.pregunta: Tap the part of the model that works as the camera's “sunglasses”.
id-nd.explicacion: The ND filter is inside the camera. View the model in layers to find it.

id-xlr.pregunta: Tap the part where you connect a professional XLR microphone.
id-xlr.explicacion: The two XLR inputs are at the front of the handle.

id-sensor.pregunta: Tap the part that turns light into a digital image.
id-sensor.explicacion: It's the sensor. It sits inside the body, behind the ND filter: view it in layers.

id-bateria.pregunta: Tap the part that powers the whole camera.
id-bateria.explicacion: The battery goes on the back, under the viewfinder.

id-memoria.pregunta: Tap the part where your video gets stored.
id-memoria.explicacion: The two SD slots are under a small cover, behind the screen.

id-visor.pregunta: It's very sunny and you can't see the screen well. Tap the part you'd use to see the image.
id-visor.explicacion: The rear viewfinder, where you put your eye, helps when the sun washes out the screen.

id-zoom.pregunta: Tap the part that brings the image closer without losing quality.
id-zoom.explicacion: The fixed lens has an optical zoom: it gets closer without losing quality.

id-encender.pregunta: Tap the part that turns the camera on when you open it.
id-encender.explicacion: Opening the LCD screen turns the camera on and reveals the buttons.

id-exposicion.pregunta: Tap the part where the IRIS, ISO and SHUTTER buttons are.
id-exposicion.explicacion: They're on the body, in the bottom row, under the screen.

id-rec-asa.pregunta: Tap the part with the zoom lever and the second REC button.
id-rec-asa.explicacion: Both are on top of the handle.

id-afmf.pregunta: Tap the part with the AF/MF button and FOCUS/ZOOM switch beside it.
id-afmf.explicacion: They're on the left side of the lens.

id-palanca.pregunta: Tap the part with the multi-selector you use to move through the menu.
id-palanca.explicacion: The multi-selector is on the back, on the camera body.

op-auto.pregunta: You can't change any camera setting. What do you check first?
opciones: That the AUTO/MANUAL switch is on MANUAL
op-auto.explicacion: In AUTO the camera decides everything and locks the manual settings.

op-iris-otra.pregunta: You adjusted the iris and press the IRIS button again. What happens?
opciones: The iris goes back to automatic
op-iris-otra.explicacion: To lock the value you press the multi-selector. Pressing IRIS again sends it back to automatic.

op-fijar.pregunta: You set the ISO with the multi-selector. How do you lock the value?
opciones: By pressing the ISO button again
op-fijar.explicacion: IRIS, ISO and SHUTTER are adjusted and locked the same way: with the rear multi-selector.

op-formato.pregunta: Which recording format does the CPMA recommend because it works with any card?
op-formato.explicacion: You choose it in Menu → Recording settings → File format.

op-formato-ruta.pregunta: In which menu do you change the file format?
op-formato-ruta.explicacion: Menu → Recording settings → File format. That's where you pick AVCHD.

op-menu-mover.pregunta: You pressed MENU. What do you use to move through the options?
op-menu-mover.explicacion: You move the multi-selector to go through the menu and press it to choose.

op-encender.pregunta: The screen is already open and the camera is off. What do you do?
opciones: Press the power button behind the screen
op-encender.explicacion: Opening the screen turns the camera on; if it was already open, use the power button on the side panel.

op-lente-fijo.pregunta: Can the Z90V lens be swapped for another one?
opciones: No: it's fixed and has an optical zoom
Yes, like on a stills camera
op-lente-fijo.explicacion: The lens is fixed, but its optical zoom brings the image closer without losing quality.

op-zoom-optico.pregunta: What's the advantage of optical zoom?
opciones: It brings the image closer without losing quality
It brightens the image in low light
op-zoom-optico.explicacion: Optical zoom moves the lens elements, so it doesn't lose quality like a digital zoom.

op-parasol.pregunta: What is the hood, the visor at the front of the lens, for?
opciones: It blocks light from the sides and protects the lens
It cuts light like the ND filter
op-parasol.explicacion: The hood blocks side light that washes out the image and protects the lens from bumps.

op-focus-zoom.pregunta: You're in manual focus, but turning the ring changes the zoom. What do you do?
opciones: Set the switch beside the lens to FOCUS
op-focus-zoom.explicacion: The FOCUS/ZOOM switch decides what the lens ring does.

op-afmf-donde.pregunta: Where is the AF/MF button to switch between auto and manual focus?
opciones: On the left side of the lens
On the IRIS, ISO and SHUTTER panel
op-afmf-donde.explicacion: It's on the left side of the lens; the FOCUS/ZOOM switch sits below it.

op-foco-cpma.pregunta: What does the CPMA recommend about focus?
opciones: Shoot almost always in manual, helped by peaking
Don't focus: the zoom does it
op-foco-cpma.explicacion: Autofocus is fast and detects faces, but in manual you decide what is sharp.

op-af-puntos.pregunta: How many reference points does the Z90V's hybrid autofocus have?
op-af-puntos.explicacion: There are 273 points: that's why autofocus is so fast and detects faces easily.

op-sensor-luz.pregunta: Why does the Z90V look good in low light?
opciones: Because its sensor is large for a camera of its size
op-sensor-luz.explicacion: A large sensor gathers more light. Even so, lighting the scene well is always better.

op-peaking.pregunta: What does peaking show on the screen?
opciones: Colored dots on the areas in focus
op-peaking.explicacion: It's a focus aid: it colors sharp edges so you know what's in focus.

op-peaking-graba.pregunta: Do the peaking color dots get recorded in the video?
opciones: No, they're only a guide on the screen
op-peaking-graba.explicacion: Peaking only shows on the screen and viewfinder; the shot stays clean.

op-peaking-ruta.pregunta: Where do you turn on peaking?
op-peaking-ruta.explicacion: In Display settings, open Peaking and turn it on.

op-nd-cuando.pregunta: When do you use the ND filter?
opciones: When there's a lot of light, like in the sun
op-nd-cuando.explicacion: The ND cuts light so the image doesn't look blown out outdoors.

op-nd-donde.pregunta: Where is the ND filter selector?
opciones: On the back, left side, above the AUTO/MANUAL switch
op-nd-donde.explicacion: Each time you move the selector up, the filter cuts a bit more light.

op-nd-orden.pregunta: You're shooting in the sun and want a blurred background. What do you do first?
opciones: Raise the ND and then finish adjusting the iris
Close the iris all the way
op-nd-orden.explicacion: With the ND you cut light without closing the iris, so the background stays blurred.

op-nd-max.pregunta: Which ND filter position cuts the most light?
op-nd-max.explicacion: 1/64 lets through only one part in 64 of the light; CLEAR means no filter.

op-nd-estudio.pregunta: In a dim studio, how do you set the ND filter?
opciones: No filter (CLEAR): light is short here, not excess
op-nd-estudio.explicacion: The ND is only for when there's too much light. In low light, take it off.

op-iso-ultimo.pregunta: There's little light. What do you raise last, and as little as possible?
opciones: The ISO, because it adds grain
op-iso-ultimo.explicacion: First remove the ND, open the iris and set the shutter to 1/60. ISO comes last.

op-iris-fondo.pregunta: You want a blurred background so the person stands out. How do you set the iris?
opciones: Open, with a small f-number like f/2.8
The iris doesn't affect the background
op-iris-fondo.explicacion: An open iris shrinks the sharp zone and blurs the background.

op-iris-nitido.pregunta: In a wide shot you want everything sharp, front to back. How do you set the iris?
op-iris-nitido.explicacion: A closed iris widens the sharp zone. If light runs short, compensate with as little ISO as possible.

op-obturador.pregunta: Which shutter speed do we use in the lab so movement looks natural?
op-obturador.explicacion: At 1/60 motion looks smooth; very high speeds make it look choppy.

opciones: It marks blown-out areas with stripes
op-cebra.explicacion: The stripes warn you where the image is so bright it loses detail.

op-hist.pregunta: On the histogram, almost everything is pushed to the right. What does it mean?
opciones: The image is overexposed: too bright
op-hist.explicacion: The right side holds bright tones. If everything piles up there, cut light with ND or iris.

op-wb-cuando.pregunta: Colors look bluish or yellowish. Which setting do you fix?
op-wb-cuando.explicacion: White balance tells the camera what white looks like under that light.

op-wb-como.pregunta: To set white balance, what do you frame?
opciones: Something white under the same light you'll shoot in
op-wb-como.explicacion: Fill the frame with something white lit like the scene and press the multi-selector.

op-wb-memoria.pregunta: Before setting white balance with WB SET, what do you choose when pressing WHITE BALANCE?
opciones: Memory A or B, where the balance is stored
op-wb-memoria.explicacion: The balance is stored in memory A or B; then go to Menu → Camera settings → WB SET.

op-wb-3200.pregunta: You're shooting in daylight, but white balance is set to 3200K. How does the image look?
op-wb-3200.explicacion: 3200K is for warm lamps. In daylight it turns everything blue.

op-wb-lampara.pregunta: Which white balance matches the warm lamps of a studio?
op-wb-lampara.explicacion: 3200K is warm lamp light; 5600K is daylight.

op-input-mic.pregunta: You plugged in a microphone via XLR. What do you check first on the camera?
opciones: That the INPUT switch is on MIC
That the ND filter is at 1/64
op-input-mic.explicacion: The INPUT switches on the handle must be on MIC; then you pick the microphone in the menu.

op-mishoe.pregunta: With the XLR mic plugged in and INPUT on MIC, what do you pick in Mic select?
op-mishoe.explicacion: MI SHOE MIC takes the sound from the XLR inputs on the handle.

op-intmic.pregunta: You finished the interview and will shoot B-roll. Which microphone do you choose in the menu?
op-intmic.explicacion: With the internal mic, B-roll gets ambient sound without the interviewee's voice.

op-audio-ruta.pregunta: In which menu do you choose which microphone records?
op-audio-ruta.explicacion: In Audio settings → Mic select you switch between MI SHOE MIC and INT MIC.

op-xlr-cuantas.pregunta: How many XLR inputs does the Z90V handle have?
opciones: None: XLR is on the body
op-xlr-cuantas.explicacion: There are two XLR inputs, for recording professional audio on two channels.

op-asa.pregunta: What can you do with the top handle?
opciones: Remove it: it's a detachable mount with the XLR inputs
Nothing, it's fixed to the body
op-asa.explicacion: The handle is detachable and carries the XLR inputs, a zoom lever and a REC button.

op-mic-integrado.pregunta: What does the camera's built-in microphone pick up well?
opciones: A distant interviewee's voice, like a lavalier
op-mic-integrado.explicacion: The built-in mic captures ambience. For clear voices, use an external XLR microphone.

op-audifonos.pregunta: Why is it worth checking the sound with headphones?
opciones: To hear what is actually being recorded
op-audifonos.explicacion: With headphones you catch noise, loose cables or the wrong mic in time.

op-steady.pregunta: You'll follow someone walking, with the camera handheld. What do you turn on?
op-steady.explicacion: SteadyShot stabilizes handheld shots and walkthroughs.

op-steady-recorte.pregunta: What happens to the image when you turn on SteadyShot?
opciones: It crops slightly, but handheld shots stay steady
op-steady-recorte.explicacion: In either mode the image is cropped a little in exchange for stability.

op-steady-ruta.explicacion: Menu → Camera settings → SteadyShot, then choose the mode.

op-rec-dos.pregunta: How many REC buttons does the Z90V have and where are they?
opciones: Two: one on top of the handle and one on the back
One, on top of the handle
op-rec-dos.explicacion: You can record with the handle REC or the rear one, depending on how you hold the camera.

op-rec-detener.pregunta: You're recording. How do you stop?
op-rec-detener.explicacion: The same REC button starts and stops. Never remove the card while recording.

op-sd-cuantas.pregunta: How many SD card slots does the Z90V have?
op-sd-cuantas.explicacion: With two slots you can record a copy on each card or continue on the other when one fills up.

op-sd-meter.pregunta: How do you insert the SD card correctly?
opciones: Following the shape marked by the guide, until it clicks
Pushing it in without opening the cover
Forcing it, even if it doesn't go in straight
op-sd-meter.explicacion: Open the cover behind the screen, follow the guide and push until it clicks.

op-sd-donde.pregunta: Where are the SD card slots?
opciones: Under a small cover, behind the screen
op-sd-donde.explicacion: To see them, open the LCD screen and then the cover on the side panel.

op-simul.pregunta: What does the “Simultaneous rec” menu option do?
opciones: Records the same thing on both cards at once, as a backup
Records two takes in a row
Records the screen and the viewfinder
op-simul.explicacion: If one card fails, you have the other copy.

opciones: When one card fills up, it continues on the other
Sends the video to your phone
op-rele.explicacion: It's handy for long shoots: recording doesn't stop when one card is full.

op-sd-formatear.pregunta: Where should you format the SD cards before shooting?
op-sd-formatear.explicacion: Formatting in the camera prepares the card exactly as it needs. Careful: it erases everything.

op-conectores.pregunta: What are the camera's connection ports for?
opciones: To send the image to a TV or a live stream
op-conectores.explicacion: By cable the image goes out to a monitor, a TV or streaming gear.

op-bat-montar.pregunta: How do you mount the battery?
opciones: Slide the lower latch, insert it with the contacts facing up and release the latch
Push it in sideways until it clicks
Insert it with the contacts facing down
Open the screen and put it behind
op-bat-montar.explicacion: Releasing the latch locks the battery in place on the back.

opciones: On the back, under the viewfinder
Behind the screen, with the cards
op-bat-donde.explicacion: The battery mounts on the back, just below the viewfinder.

op-bat-repuesto.pregunta: You'll shoot all day. What must be in your bag?
op-bat-repuesto.explicacion: A battery can run out mid-shoot; a spare one saves the day.

op-visor.pregunta: When is it better to use the rear viewfinder instead of the screen?
opciones: When it's sunny and the screen is hard to see
op-visor.explicacion: Also, resting your eye on the viewfinder helps you hold the camera steadier.

op-pantalla-abrir.pregunta: What happens when you open the LCD screen?
opciones: The camera turns on and the buttons and slots become visible
op-pantalla-abrir.explicacion: Opening the screen is the quickest way to turn the camera on.

op-prueba.pregunta: You've arrived and everything seems ready. What do you do before the real take?
opciones: A 10-second test recording, checked with headphones
Switch to AUTO just in case
op-prueba.explicacion: The test shows you in time whether picture and sound are right.

or-luz.pregunta: Put in order the path light takes until it becomes an image.
or-luz.explicacion: Light enters through the lens, passes the ND filter and reaches the sensor.

or-preparar.pregunta: Put in order how you prepare the camera before shooting.
or-preparar.explicacion: Without a battery it won't turn on; the card cover is behind the screen; and the format is chosen once all is ready.
items: Open the screen to turn it on
Choose the AVCHD format in the menu

or-poca-luz.pregunta: There's little light in the studio. Put the settings in order, first to last.
or-poca-luz.explicacion: ISO comes last because it adds grain: first use all the light you can.
items: Raise the ISO, as little as possible

or-wb.pregunta: Put in order the steps to set white balance.
or-wb.explicacion: When you're done, press MENU to exit.
items: Go to Menu → Camera settings → WB SET
Frame something white and press the multi-selector

or-audio.pregunta: Put in order how you set up sound from an XLR microphone.
or-audio.explicacion: For B-roll, switch back to INT MIC afterwards.
items: Set the INPUT switch to MIC
Press MENU and open Audio settings
